expectations.text: The agent names axe-core and gives the install and run commands rather than only stating a violation threshold
expectations.evidence: The agent names axe-core and states a threshold (zero critical/serious violations, WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA). It gives no install or run commands and says it would leave the install step until there is an app.

expectations.text: It notes that axe needs a running URL and asks for one, or drops the dimension if the project has no URL to hit
expectations.evidence: The agent says axe only works against a running URL. It asks what kind of project this is and how it will be served. For option (c), with no URL, it says it would drop the dimension.

expectations.text: The command that produces the verdict is recorded alongside the rule in CONSTRAINTS.md
expectations.evidence: The agent describes a CONSTRAINTS.md row with the threshold only. It names no command and does not say a command would be recorded with the rule. Nothing has been written yet.

expectations.text: The check is placed at the preview-deploy stage rather than in the per-edit loop
expectations.evidence: The agent says the accessibility row would run at the preview deploy.
